scheme_name: Sympathetic Assistance and Handholding for Youth Transformation and Amelioration - SAHAYTA
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jammu and Kashmir and be a victim of an insurgency‑related incident (loss of a family member or permanent incapacitation) in that region.
Permanent incapacitation is defined as a disability of 50% or more that is permanent and prevents the victim from working.
Persons involved in anti‑national activities, directly or indirectly, and their family members are not eligible for assistance.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 financial assistance for setting up a self‑employment venture; any cost exceeding this amount must be self‑financed or obtained as a Mudra loan.
documents_required: Certificate regarding non‑involvement in militancy/anti‑national activities from the concerned SDPO
Death cum Post Mortem Certificate (if applicable)
Medical Certificate (in case of incapacitation of 50% and above)
Proof showing relationship of the beneficiary with the victim (not required if victim is the claimant)
Project report/details about the self‑employment unit to be set up by the applicant
Undertaking/NOC from other family members that they have no objection to the benefit under the scheme
